text.en:
Regulation No. 33(a) of Letter of Implementation No. 23, as amended, is hereby further amended to
read as follows:
"Regulation No. 33 Disqualifications. Members under any of the following circumstances are disqualified to
be voted upon to the position of director or committee member or continue as such in any Kilusang Bayan:
(a) Holding any elective position in the government except barangay captains and councilmen.

This order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 21st day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-two.
